Moment_captions.AT_THE_BEACH: Give me some sunshine, the sea, and a little free time and I'm happy.
Moment_captions.WATCHING_THE_SUNSET: I never get tired of stopping for a beautiful sunset, wherever I happen to be.

Rules.title: Rules of Engagement
Rules.subtitle: Please agree to our community standards before exploring matches.
Rules.respect_desc: Harassment, hate speech, threats, or toxic behavior will result in an immediate permanent ban.
Rules.media_desc: Every single moment shared must include your actual image or short video. True authenticity is the hallmark of this platform.
Rules.moment_desc: You can create public or match only moments, however to send a match request, you must have at least one public moment
Rules.safety_desc: Never share your password, banking information, or physical addresses with people you just met.
